name: Top Bar Menu
description: Custom menu bar with File (Open Workspace, Exit), View (Terminal submenu, Explorer, Git, Markdown, Canvas grid style, Zoom submenu with In/Out/Reset/Lock), Tools (SpecsMap, AI, Theme), and Help (Tutorial, About) dropdowns. Renders with hover-open behavior, keyboard-accessible menu items, dynamic submenu population for terminal/git/specsmap instances, and a theme toggle button (◐). Communicates all actions via typed callbacks.

dependencies.usage: Reads theme colors for inline SVG styling (not heavily used; theme toggle is delegated via callback)

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Renders the full menu bar with all dropdowns and wires hover/keyboard events

methods.name: setTerminalItems
methods.description: Updates the terminal submenu with current open/minimized terminal instances

methods.name: setGitItems
methods.description: Updates the git submenu with current git plugin instances

methods.name: setSpecsmapItems
methods.description: Updates the specsmap submenu with current specsmap plugin instances

methods.name: setGridStyle
methods.description: Updates the grid style checkmark in Canvas submenu

methods.name: setZoomLocked
methods.description: Updates the lock checkmark in Zoom submenu
